summary: Implemented the GridPatchDataset update in monai/data/grid_dataset.py: added optional `transform` (patch-level, applied to the tuple of patches per grid position) and `with_coordinates` (default False; yields (patches, coords) with spatial slices in unpadded coordinates, not passed through the transform). Coordinates come from a helper mirroring iter_patch's padded iteration using iter_patch_slices and get_valid_patch_size. Behaviour changes to flag: start_pos now gets a leading 0 for the channel dimension (previously it was applied to the channel axis). Added tests/test_grid_patch_dataset.py. Nothing was run, per instructions; docs/source/data.rst was not edited (autoclass picks up the docstring). Nothing committed.
